name: rosetta-nth-root
code:
use IO.Std.write_line

nth_root(a: double, n: int) -> double is
    let order = cast double(n)

    let estimate mut = a / order

    do
        let power = System.Math.pow(estimate, order - 1.0)

        let next = ((order - 1.0) * estimate + a / power) / order

        if System.Math.abs(next - estimate) < 1.0e-12 then
            return next
        fi

        estimate = next
    od
si

for (a, n) in [(2.0, 2), (27.0, 3), (5.0, 5)] do
    write_line("root {n} of {a} is {nth_root(a, n):0.000000}")
